rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c='%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ht_screen_risk (
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	result int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	normal int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	risk int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	high_risk int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ill int(10) DEFAULT 0,
	ill_1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
DELETE FROM s_ht_screen_risk  WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ht_screen_risk','ill_1','int(10) DEFAULT 0 ');

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ht_screen_risk  
(
SELECT
@id,HOSPCODE,areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT cid) B
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(sbp >0 AND dbp >0  ,cid ,NULL)) A
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(risk in(0) ,cid ,NULL)) normal
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(risk in(1) ,cid ,NULL)) risk
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(risk in(2) ,cid ,NULL)) hrisk
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(ill is not null ,cid ,NULL)) ill
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(risk in(3) ,cid ,NULL)) ill_1
FROM
t_person_ht_screen s 
LEFT JOIN cage ca ON s.age_y=ca.age
INNER JOIN chospital h ON h.hoscode=s.HOSPCODE
WHERE ca.groupcode3560 in(3,4)
	AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND h.provcode in(@prov_c) 
GROUP BY HOSPCODE,areacode
);
rows.notice:
- ปกติ (Risk = 0) หมายถึง ค่าความดันโลหิต sbp มีค่า >50 ถึง <130 mmHg หรือ dbp มีค่า >50 ถึง < 80 mmHg
- เสี่ยง (Risk = 1) หมายถึง ค่าความดันโลหิต sbp มีค่า >= 130 ถึง < 140 mmHg หรือ dbp มีค่า >= 80 ถึง < 90 mmHg
- สงสัยป่วย (Risk = 2) หมายถึง ค่าความดันโลหิต sbp มีค่า >= 140 ถึง < 180 mmHg หรือ dbp มีค่า >= 90 ถึง < 110 mmHg
- ป่วย(ส่งพบแพทย์) (Risk = 3) หมายถึง ค่าความดันโลหิต sbp มีค่า >= 180 mmHg หรือ dbp มีค่า >= 110 mmHg
** มีการปรับเปลี่ยนเกณฑ์การจำแนกความรุนแรงของระดับความดันโลหิต ตามแนวทางการรักษาโรคความดันโลหิตสูงในเวชปฏิบัติทั่วไป พ.ศ. 2567 สมาคมความดันโลหิตสูงแห่งประเทศไทย

	SELECT

	FROM
	t_person_ht_screen s
	LEFT JOIN cage ca ON s.age_y=ca.age
	INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON s.cid = p.CID
	INNER JOIN chospital h ON h.hoscode=s.HOSPCODE
	WHERE ca.groupcode3560 in(3,4)
	AND h.hdc_regist=1
	);

FROM
tx d
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, sum("target") as "target", sum("result") as "result", sum("normal") as "normal", sum("risk") as "risk", sum("high_risk") as "high_risk", sum("result"-"normal"-"risk"-"high_risk"-"ill_1") as "perror", sum("ill_1") as "ill_1"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

		sum(result) as result,
		sum(normal) as normal,

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name , 		sum(target) as target, 		sum(result) as result, 		sum(normal) as normal, 		sum(risk) as risk, 		sum(high_risk) as high_risk, 		sum(result-normal-risk-high_risk-ill_1) as perror, 		sum(ill_1) as ill_1  FROM chospital as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1
